content: Customer Diya Menon inquired about the unexpected cancellation of her life insurance policy (LP-452789). Agent Suresh Deshmukh responded that the cancellation was due to an overdue premium of $150.00 from September 15, 2026, and a missing signed rider document. To reinstate the policy, the customer needs to pay the overdue premium and submit the signed rider document provided in the agent's email.

action_items: Process the overdue premium payment of $150.00
Sign and submit the rider document form
